items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a Jack Butler with me, not a Jack Sprat

ctx.x: -- with you. Do you recall Jack Sprat? It's even possible that that was a fake name for somebody.
It could have been. I had a Jack Butler with me, not a Jack Sprat, and we called him Tonics. And he was a great guy, and he was crippled fellow.
